{{Quote|&hellip;arrival was expected, and on time. Your assistance in destroying the Rebel transport will be relayed to Imperial command. Proceed to the in-system rendezvous point.|The controller speaks via comm to Zuckuss and 4-LOM|<ref name="Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''controller''' served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the battle, the ''Executor'' worked in tandem with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the hunters [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], to disable the fleeing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']]. Afterward, the [[Controller/Legends|controller]] [[Comm unit/Legends|communicated]] with the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting duo, directing them to rendezvous with the ''Executor'' within the nearby [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] to join the Imperials' preplanned hunt for Rebel fugitive [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
